input_and_continuity.finding: Both complete-route drivers use InputEventKey through root.push_input for movement/actions/menu. No direct position, gate, stage or earned-fact injection was found. They manually step game and world by1/60 and await a rendering frame every2ticks; native trace fast mode is false.

input_and_continuity.not_raw_key_replay: Trace is sampled state plus semantic sound/event notifications and assertions, not a complete key-event replay log. The ordinary-input claim is grounded in reviewed driver code together with native results.
input_and_continuity.continuity_boundary: One chronological movie per route includes real menu pauses and scene destruction/recreation reading actual disk. This does not constitute executable/process cold launch or packaged-app launch verification.
